title: Page 26
transc:
Ft Monroe Feb 10 . 1864 
Geo W Baldwin Balto
Vienna mulford swindle midas insanity period
the Vernon desires to know where
A F Brengle has gone whom
you brought down on flag of 
truce boat answer immed'y to me one
signed John I Davenport private secretary
to audit Clara Clear and Cool
Geo D Sheldon


Balto Feb 10 1864
Geo D Sheldon Ft. M.
Abbey Hammock period Brengle
is in this City
I will find him
and wait orders he
lives in free derrick
Camargo signed John E
Mulford Village &c Rosetta
GW Baldwin


Balto Feb 11 1864
Geo D Sheldon Ft. M
abbey have just found
Brengle will send him
down tonight prisoners not
yet arrived John E
Mulford Vienna &c Cora 
GW Baldwin
